scope: One terminal Ethereum-SHA-profile CPU segment with a four-byte public input, four-byte public output, output-length and halt stores, and one Keccak caller; fresh block-v4 core verification only

bytes.payload_excludes: Separate claim arrays, pinned statement, roster metadata, and verifier-visible public source files

fixture_limits: The 2040-byte public image includes initialized Keccak state; it is not the public-I/O overhead alone.
The trusted public job and native key were derived in a separate fixture preflight; a production caller must pin them independently.
This is a small core proof with real I/O, not a recursive complete-block proof or an Ethereum mainnet block measurement.

postrun_address_bound_refinement.change: The byte-address bridge was subsequently restricted below 2^30 to match the native typed load/store quarter-index bound and remove an M31 packing-edge alias. The measured fixture addresses are below this limit.
